verdicts.quote: Automatic promotion, no claim window. A freed spot books the first eligible waitlisted member directly and notifies them
Entries are ordered first come, first served by join order, with no ties. ... Left out: moving a member up, swapping places, priority by membership age.
the member may cancel under the existing rules. ... Revisit if cancelling a promoted booking carries a penalty (G-3).
verdicts.missing: Whether cancelling or missing a promoted booking counts against the existing late-cancel/no-show policy; G-3 leaves that policy and its effect open.

verdicts.quote: A spot is freed when a booked member cancels, when staff cancel or remove a booking ... or when capacity is raised; Promotion completes inside the freeing request; only the message is asynchronous, after commit.
through the existing booking channel (A-5) ... Promoted: subject "You're in: Spin, Tue 1 Dec 18:00" ... A notification failure never undoes a booking or a removal
At all times booked <= capacity; each entry is promoted at most once; each freed spot goes to at most one member; ... M1 and M2 cancel concurrently: exactly M3 and M4 booked (each once)
A member has at most one entry per class and is never both booked and waiting in the same class. ... A member who becomes booked in a class by any path has that class's entry removed.
verdicts.missing: The concurrent case itself: what happens when the waitlisted member's own direct booking races their promotion (one booking, which path wins, which response they get).

verdicts.quote: The waitlist is free: no fee, penalty or no-show rule
verdicts.missing: Whether a promoted booking for a paid class takes payment, when, and what happens if payment fails.

verdicts.quote: Class full, open, waitlist already has 10 entries | WAITLIST_FULL: "The waitlist for this class is full (10 of 10)."
The waitlist freezes at the cutoff. From the cutoff instant no one can join and no one is promoted. (A-3: Cutoff is 60 minutes before the class start instant)
when capacity is raised (the number freed is new capacity minus booked, if positive); (e) A capacity decrease below the booked count does not touch entries.
(b) When a class is cancelled, every entry is removed and each member notified (R-6).
An entry holds only the member ID, class ID and join order. (AD-3: position is the count of entries with a lower sequence, plus one.)
Entries are deleted with the class's booking records under the existing retention (A-6, G-4) and immediately on account deletion
No payload, page or message sent to a member includes another member's name, email or ID; the only information about others is the aggregate count and own position.
Whether staff need to see or edit waitlists. Left out, not decided
verdicts.missing: Any staff view of the waitlist, manual promote/remove, and a record of who was promoted when.

verdicts.quote: after any join, leave or cancel response returns, the next read by any client reflects it (read-your-write; no delayed promotion)
For a class with a free spot, booking, cancelling and viewing behave exactly as before this change, including the existing eligibility and cancellation rules
Out of scope: staff views, reports, migration of historical data (no entries exist before this change)
verdicts.missing: Whether classes already full at launch immediately offer Join waitlist, and how members already turned away are handled.
